example.prompt: Tap the flawed statement about chlorine residual minimums.

options.label: A combined chlorine residual of 0.25 mg/L meets the chloramination minimum under O. Reg. 170/03, Sched. 1, s. 1-2 (2) 4 (ii).
A free chlorine residual of 0.05 mg/L meets the minimum where the system chlorinates and does not chloramine, under O. Reg. 170/03, Sched. 1, s. 1-2 (2) 4 (i).
A combined residual of 0.05 mg/L meets the chloramination minimum.

example.explanation: The chloramination minimum is 0.25 mg/L (s. 1-2 (2) 4 (ii)); 0.05 mg/L is the chlorination minimum.
